facts.fact: Open Access Data Centres (OADC, controlled by Wiocc) already operates data centres in Johannesburg, Durban and Cape Town offering colocation and connectivity services.
facts.system: Open Access Data Centres (OADC) Johannesburg, Durban, Cape Town

facts.fact: NTT Data South Africa operates seven data centre facilities (Bloemfontein, Cape Town, East London, Bryanston, Parklands in Johannesburg, Gqeberha, Umhlanga) offering colocation, which OADC was cleared to acquire by the Competition Commission.
